# System requirements

The system catalog connects business expectations to the Aegis IAM architecture.

::: {.need #SYS-001 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="authentication;security" derives-from="STK-001" implemented-by="COMP-001" verified-by="TC-001"}
## Authenticate identities before issuing a session

Aegis IAM shall authenticate the identity before issuing a usable session.

### Rationale

Prevents protected resources from being exposed to anonymous requesters.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-002 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="authorization;least-privilege" derives-from="STK-002" implemented-by="COMP-002" verified-by="TC-004"}
## Decide access through central policy

The system shall decide access through centralized policies and trusted attributes.

### Rationale

Centralizing the decision reduces divergence among consuming applications.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-003 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="lifecycle;provisioning" derives-from="STK-003" implemented-by="COMP-003" verified-by="TC-007"}
## Manage the account lifecycle

The system shall provision, modify, suspend, and terminate accounts in an auditable manner.

### Rationale

Orphan accounts and persistent privileges are significant operational risks.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-004 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="audit;compliance" derives-from="STK-005" implemented-by="COMP-004" verified-by="TC-010"}
## Record immutable identity events

The system shall record authentication, authorization, and administration events.

### Rationale

Integrity-preserving records support investigation, compliance, and accountability.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-005 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="high" tags="recovery;security" derives-from="STK-003" implemented-by="COMP-005" verified-by="TC-012"}
## Recover access with identity proofing

The system shall recover access only after identity validation proportional to risk.

### Rationale

The recovery process must not become an account-takeover path.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-006 type="system-requirement" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="integration;standards" derives-from="STK-004" implemented-by="IF-001" verified-by="TC-017"}
## Expose standardized identity integration

The system shall provide open federation and provisioning protocols.

### Rationale

Standardized protocols reduce integration cost and risk.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-007 type="system-requirement" status="in-review" priority="medium" tags="analytics;governance" derives-from="STK-005"}
## Detect privilege anomalies

The system shall prioritize anomalous access patterns for review.

### Rationale

Anomaly analysis may surface privilege abuse earlier.
:::

::: {.need #SYS-008 type="system-requirement" status="draft" priority="low" tags="experience;mobile" derives-from="STK-004"}
## Offer a corporate mobile credential

The system may provide a mobile credential for physical access.

### Rationale

The need depends on a joint physical-security and privacy assessment.
:::
